newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold opens first supermarkets in Malaysia.
newsitem.headline: Ahold opens first supermarkets in Malaysia.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV said on Thursday it would open two pilot Tops supermarkets in Malaysia this week with its joint venture partner Perlis plantations Bhd, Kuok Group.
"The openings are significant, as they represent the beginning of a new style of food shopping of Asian consumers in the coming years," Ahold said in a statement.

"To realise our plans in Asia, we will contribute not only financial recources, but also our vast experience uncluding distribution and logistics know-how, consumer research, information technology, personal training and merchandising," said Eddie Moerk, member of Ahold's Corporate Executive Board.
Beside Malaysia, Ahold plans to operate Tops supermarket chains in Indonesia, Singapore and Thailand, it said.
